summary: Independent cold screening of the 20-page manuscript (main.tex, references.bib, main.pdf, and Figures 1-3) for arXiv passes all hard compliance gates with zero blockers. Only a human author is listed, Google Antigravity/Gemini workflow roles with explicit human verification and Google Antigravity for Science support are transparently disclosed, bibliographic spot-checks confirm zero hallucinated citations, mathematical proofs match stated assumptions with explicit finite-sample CV caveats, and clinical readmission analyses on de-identified public data are properly framed as retrospective methodological benchmarks.

warnings.detail: Three public benchmark cohorts (Scania APS, Home Credit Default Risk, and IEEE-CIS Fraud Detection) are named in the text, Ethics/Data statement, and Table 6 without dedicated dataset bibliography entries or persistent repository URLs/DOIs in references.bib (unlike UCI Diabetes, UCI Taiwan, NeurIPS BAF, and OpenML).

In Theorem 1 Eq. (3), the cluster count C and cluster partition index g appear in the Phase-1 variance estimator V_I before being explicitly defined in Appendix A (L420); defining C via the Phase-1 cluster identifier G_i inside Theorem 1 would improve self-containedness.

In Table 4 (Scania APS, Streaming VOI at q=20%, 14.98) and Figure 2 (panel 4), non-strict thresholding R(x) >= gamma_0.20 = 0 across point-mass ties at VOI=0 results in a 100% realized query rate (matching Full Stage-2 = 14.98); noting this tie-induced jump to 100% realized queries in Footnote dagger would clarify the alignment between Table 4 and Figure 2.
